consequence.statement: Purely additive opt-in capability: operators who do not pass --extra-certificate-annotations see no change, while those who set it get the listed annotation keys copied from an Ingress or Gateway resource to the resulting Certificate object.
consequence.remediation: Optionally set --extra-certificate-annotations on the controller to copy selected annotation keys from Ingress or Gateway resources to the resulting Certificate objects.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds a new configuration option to the cert-manager controller, --extra-certificate-annotations, which specifies annotation keys to be copied from an Ingress or Gateway resource to the resulting Certificate object.
